title: 'El R-1' (Los Rs Cell Leader) Arrested in Atotonilco el Alto — Linked to Valeria Márquez Femicide and Mayor Carlos Manzo Assassination
detail: Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala ('El R-1'), leader of 'Los Rs,' a CJNG-linked armed cell operating across Jalisco and Michoacán, was captured July 30, 2026 during a federal special-forces operation in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco, after a brief armed confrontation in which one associate was killed. Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch said investigators believe Álvarez Ayala ordered the May 2025 livestreamed femicide of TikTok influencer Valeria Márquez at the request of his son Francisco, who had dated and repeatedly threatened her. Authorities separately allege Álvarez Ayala financed and ordered the November 2025 assassination of Uruapan, Michoacán Mayor Carlos Manzo, an outspoken organized-crime critic — a case that had already produced 31 prior arrests. He faces charges including weapons possession, possession of ammunition reserved for the armed forces, and intent to traffic methamphetamine and cocaine.

media.caption: Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala ('El R-1'), Los Rs/CJNG cell leader arrested July 30, 2026

title: 'El R-1' Formally Charged (Vinculado a Proceso), Ordered Held at Altiplano
detail: A Mexican federal judge formally linked Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala ('El R-1') to trial (vinculación a proceso) on August 7, 2026, for weapons possession, possession of cartridges reserved for the armed forces, and intent to traffic methamphetamine hydrochloride and cocaine. The judge ratified preventive detention and granted prosecutors a three-month window to complete supplementary investigation, including the homicide allegations tied to the Valeria Márquez femicide and the assassination of Uruapan Mayor Carlos Manzo. He is held at the Altiplano federal maximum-security prison and has filed an amparo alleging torture and incommunicado detention in an attempt to block eventual extradition to the United States.

media.caption: 'El R1' ordered held at Altiplano prison after being formally charged, August 7, 2026
